description: Adds copies of the selected pages, right after each one or all at the end, named with -duplicated. Copies share the page's images, so the file barely grows. One call can add at most 10,000 pages. Writes the result as a new file next to the input (or to output_path) and never replaces an existing file; the input is left unchanged.

copies.description: Extra copies of each page. Default 1.

output_path.description: Optional absolute path for the new PDF, ending in .pdf. It must not exist yet. By default the result goes next to the input.

pages.description: Pages to copy, such as "2", "1-3, 5" or "4-end". Commas separate parts.

path.description: Absolute path to a PDF file, or one starting with ~/.

placement.description: "after" (default) puts copies right after each page; "end" adds them at the end.

name: duplicate_pages

output_path.description: Where the new PDF was written

title: Duplicate pages
